summary: Old Republic International Corporation filed an 8-K to report entry into an underwriting agreement for a registered public offering of $700M aggregate principal amount of 5.700% Senior Notes due 2036, priced on May 13, 2026. The notes were sold through an underwriting agreement with Morgan Stanley and PNC Capital Markets, with a preliminary and final prospectus supplement filed under an existing shelf registration. The notes mature on June 1, 2036, pay semi-annual interest, and contain customary covenants and event-of-default provisions. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation.
